# reqwest provenance

- Crate: `reqwest`
- Version: `0.13.5`
- Upstream: https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- MALENJO use: local loopback HTTP client for Ollama and llama.cpp servers
